newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end sharply lower.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end sharply lower.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended sharply lower on Monday, weighed down by expectations of ample supplies in the short-term and a stronger yen against the dollar, traders said.
At midday, spot February expired 0.5 yen per kg firmer at 147.9. A total of 386 deliveries were made.
Other contracts closed 3.1 to 5.4 yen weaker, with benchmark July finishing 3.1 down at 151.0.
Market sentiment turned bearish in the afternoon session due to the firmer yen and on speculation that deliveries were taken by traders and not by end-users, traders said.
